title: Add Fish Speech and additional TTS backends
description: Implement Fish Speech, Coqui XTTS-v2, and Bark backends behind the pluggable TTS interfaces in worker-image and cli. Register all backends, add runtime dependencies, preserve lazy model imports, and verify formatting, lint, and tests.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented Fish Speech, Coqui XTTS-v2, and Bark backends in cli and worker-image, registered all three, and added runtime dependencies. Acceptance checks pass: CLI black, Ruff, and 7 pytest tests; worker-image black and Ruff.

right_now_summary: Fish Speech, Coqui XTTS-v2, and Bark backends are implemented, registered, and passing formatting, lint, and tests.
